Description:
Add a vibrant twist to your jewelry collection with this eye-catching set of multicolor spiral glass bangles! available in six bold and playful hues—green, pink, yellow, blue, orange, and peach—each bangle showcases a unique spiral design for a modern, stylish look. The glossy finish and vivid colors make these bangles the perfect accessory for weddings, parties, festivals, and everyday ethnic wear.
Expertly handcrafted from high-quality glass, these bangles are lightweight, durable, and comfortable for all-day wear. Their striking spiral design adds extra flair to traditional outfits like sarees, lehengas, salwar suits, as well as fusion ensembles. Whether shopping for festive jewelry, bridal accessories, or a special gift, this multicolor spiral set brings energy and charm to any occasion.
Key Features:
- Multicolor spiral glass bangles available in six stylish shades
- Contemporary spiral design with glossy finish
- Handcrafted for outstanding durability and comfort
- Lightweight for daily wear and festive occasions
- Perfect for weddings, parties, festivals, and gifting
- Complements traditional and modern ethnic attire
